note: dw-check and dw-land both render a verdict over a diff. The whole distinction is timing — mid-build and repeatable versus once at the end, promoting residue — so the negatives put that boundary under load rather than picking distant skills. The outside-reviewer positive stays because dw-check is still where an outside pass is arranged — it offers one after reading the diff itself — so asking for a reviewer is a way in and not a synonym for typing /codex:review.
